tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rnam par rgyal ma'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs la bstod pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ru uṣ+ṇi ṣa bi dzā ya/ spros bral mkha' dbyings dag pa'i rang bzhin las/ /thugs rjes 'gag med rdo rje'i phreng ba'i dbus/ /thub dbang bzhugs gnas rin chen gzhal yas khang / /rten 'brel rnam dag byang chos ngo bor bstod/ /de dbus pad+ma'i lte bar rang bzhin la/ /'chi med dbang mo rang bzhin 'byung ba'i lha/ /rnam par rgyal ma zhal gsum phyag brgyad sku/ /phyag mtshan rgyan dang na bzas mdzes la bstod/ /gang gi rang bzhin mkha' ltar rnam dag pas/ /sna tshogs spros pa'i drwa ba mthar mdzad pa'i/ /zag med yon tan phung po'i gzhir gyur pa/ /rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor chos skur bstod/ /'og min la sogs dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /yid 'ong mtshan dpes rab mdzes mchog gi skus/ /gdul bya dag pa'i bsam pa tshim mdzad pa/ /rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor longs skur bstod/ /bsam yas gdul bya'i bsam pa ji bzhin du/ /sna tshogs gzugs dang dam chos sna tshogs kyis/ /'gro ba'i re 'dod yongs su rdzogs mdzad pa/ /rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor sprul skur bstod/ /gtso mo'i phyi rol 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la/ /nam mkha' nor bu dpag med rnga yi sgra/ /'byung ba'i gtsug tor rnam bzhi phyogs mdog can/ /phyag rgya rgyan dang na bzas mdzes la bstod/ /mtshams bzhir sa snying rdul snying gzi brjid snying / /rlung gi sgra dbyangs rnam bzhi sngo ser dmar/ ljang mdangs mchog sbyin mnyam bzhag tshe bum can/ /dar gos rin chen rgyan gyis spras la 'dud/ /de yi phyi rol pad 'dab bcu drug la/ /stong nyid bcu drug 'byung ba'i gtsug tor dmar/ /sprul sku'i rnam rol mnyam bzhag tshe bum 'dzin/ /yang dag tshe yi dngos grub stsol la bstod/ /sgo bzhir bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i lha mo bzhi/ /mtshams bzhir 'chi med stsol mdzad tshe yum bzhi/

/phyogs mdog rang rang phyag mtshan rgyan na bza'/ /'gro la dngos grub kun stsol rnams la bstod/ /de ltar bstod pas bdag sogs sems can rnams/ /'chi bdag las rgyal tshe bsod blo gros dang / /byang sems rnam gnyis la sogs dge legs kun/ /rab rgyas rnam par rgyal ma nyid gyur cig/ //ces kri ya sa muñtsa'i dge legs su byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum las rnam par rgyal ma'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs la bstod pa 'di yang sa skya pa kun blos bris// //༄༅/ /rnam par rgyal ma'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs la bstod pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ru uṣ+ṇi ṣa bi dzā ya/ spros bral mkha' dbyings dag pa'i rang bzhin las/ /thugs rjes 'gag med rdo rje'i phreng ba'i dbus/ /thub dbang bzhugs gnas rin chen gzhal yas khang / /rten 'brel rnam dag byang chos ngo bor bstod/ /de dbus pad+ma'i lte bar rang bzhin la/ /'chi med dbang mo rang bzhin 'byung ba'i lha/ /rnam par rgyal ma zhal gsum phyag brgyad sku/ /phyag mtshan rgyan dang na bzas mdzes la bstod/ /gang gi rang bzhin mkha' ltar rnam dag pas/ /sna tshogs spros pa'i drwa ba mthar mdzad pa'i/ /zag med yon tan phung po'i gzhir gyur pa/ /rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor chos skur bstod/ /'og min la sogs dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /yid 'ong mtshan dpes rab mdzes mchog gi skus/ /gdul bya dag pa'i bsam pa tshim mdzad pa/ /rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor longs skur bstod/ /bsam yas gdul bya'i bsam pa ji bzhin du/ /sna tshogs gzugs dang dam chos sna tshogs kyis/ /'gro ba'i re 'dod yongs su rdzogs mdzad pa/ /rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor sprul skur bstod/ /gtso mo'i phyi rol 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la/ /nam mkha' nor bu dpag med rnga yi sgra/ /'byung ba'i gtsug tor rnam bzhi phyogs mdog can/ /phyag rgya rgyan dang na bzas mdzes la bstod/ /mtshams bzhir sa snying rdul snying gzi brjid snying /

/rlung gi sgra dbyangs rnam bzhi sngo ser dmar/ ljang mdangs mchog sbyin mnyam bzhag tshe bum can/ /dar gos rin chen rgyan gyis spras la 'dud/ /de yi phyi rol pad 'dab bcu drug la/ /stong nyid bcu drug 'byung ba'i gtsug tor dmar/ /sprul sku'i rnam rol mnyam bzhag tshe bum 'dzin/ /yang dag tshe yi dngos grub stsol la bstod/ /sgo bzhir bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i lha mo bzhi/ /mtshams bzhir 'chi med stsol mdzad tshe yum bzhi/ /phyogs mdog rang rang phyag mtshan rgyan na bza'/ /'gro la dngos grub kun stsol rnams la bstod/ /de ltar bstod pas bdag sogs sems can rnams/ /'chi bdag las rgyal tshe bsod blo gros dang / /byang sems rnam gnyis la sogs dge legs kun/ /rab rgyas rnam par rgyal ma nyid gyur cig/ //ces kri ya sa muñtsa'i dge legs su byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum las rnam par rgyal ma'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs la bstod pa 'di yang sa skya pa kun blos bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ rnam rgyal ma'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs la bstod pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
